# BioMate-KB — Bioconductor Skills

> Structured, citable knowledge for 200 high-value Bioconductor R packages — the 100 most-used plus the top 100 rising-star packages (newly released, fast-growing) — when to use each, the workflows it supports, key parameters, assumptions, pitfalls, and alternatives. Run any of these analyses on your own data, free, at https://www.biomate.ai

The full 1,818-package knowledge base and managed execution are at https://www.biomate.ai.
